test_case.test_name: Standard-RAS ADDDC device sparing with plus1
test_case.purpose: Validate Standard-RAS ADDDC with plus1 enabled on approved 64GB x4 topology, proving PASSED, correctable slot attribution, normal health and both indicators off.
required_package: Approved 64GB x4 DIMM PN/population and ESD procedure
Intel package build/hash and resolved Standard-RAS plus1 recipe
test_case.test_command: After qualified x4 population installation and topology verification, an FAE runs `ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(...)` once per signed target using the exact Standard-RAS plus1-enabled recipe and fixed `adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False`. Preserve the full transcript, slot attribution, health and physical off states, then restore baseline.
test_case.expected_result: Every target reports `sparing_harasser PASSED` for the approved plus1 branch, correctable records name the mapped slot, health remains within limits, both indicators remain off, applicable UEFI agrees and baseline is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified x4 population, exact signed plus1 recipe, full coverage/PASSED transcript, correct slot/severity, health, no-light evidence and restoration. Guessed plus1, no-plus1/Advanced substitution, generic CE, self-check skip, wrong target, UCE, lamp or instability is not PASS.
safety_gate: Powered-down ESD DIMM handling and qualified operator/FAE.
Verify trained topology and every recipe value including plus1 before execution.
Stop on topology/plus1 mismatch, self-check failure, UCE, lamp, crash or health degradation.
No automatic retry or next target before complete evidence/recovery.
expected_evidence: Package hash and complete plus1 recipe/targets
Full PASSED transcript and Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI slot evidence
test_case.recovery: Preserve evidence and stop on any anomaly. Qualified operators restore the approved DIMM population and BIOS/RAS state under ESD/power controls and verify memory health before a separate rerun.
